answer: with t as (select c.Segment,c.CustomerID,sum(y.Consumption) s from customers c join yearmonth y on y.CustomerID=c.CustomerID where c.Currency='CZK' and y.Date like '2013%' group by c.CustomerID), r as (select Segment,CustomerID,s,row_number() over (partition by Segment order by s,CustomerID) rn from t where Segment in ('SME','LAM','KAM')), p as (select max(case when Segment='SME' then s end) sme,max(case when Segment='LAM' then s end) lam,max(case when Segment='KAM' then s end) kam from r where rn=1) select round(sme-lam,2) a,round(lam-kam,2) b,round(kam-sme,2) c from p

with c as (select CustomerID from transactions_1k where Date='2012-08-25' and Price=634.8) select round((sum(case when Date like '2013%' then Consumption end)-sum(case when Date like '2012%' then Consumption end))/sum(case when Date like '2012%' then Consumption end),4) from yearmonth where CustomerID in (select CustomerID from c)
select (strftime('%s',max(t.Date||' '||t.Time))-strftime('%s',min(t.Date||' '||t.Time)))/60 from transactions_1k t join gasstations g using(GasStationID) where g.Country='CZE' and t.Price>1000
